## Context

Winamp needs a small, reviewable delivery contract for agent-owned work.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The contract defines the repository boundaries.
- [ ] The offline tools have focused tests.

## Tests/Evals

Run the Python unittest suite and the repository checks listed below.

## Verification

Run the documented commands that apply to the change.

## Agent Instructions

Use one issue per worktree and stop at human boundaries.

## Out of Scope

No GitHub automation or player changes.
